card.name: Words just before a disease descriptor
card.fires_on: Short linking words or the end of a name, right before a descriptor such as endemic, viral, related, or childbearing age. Seen in disease and treatment sentences.

modes.label: Linking word before a descriptor
modes.description: A small word like are, as, of, a or considered sits just before a describing term.

modes.description: The last part of a pathogen name comes just before a word like endemic.

modes.label: Adjective or verb before related
modes.description: A word such as clearly or considered precedes a relation term like not drug-related or related to treatment.
